judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The pest-removal errand, the 'Brave Adventurer' capitalisation and the reward of a title plus library access all feel close to Nox. The giveaways are the stacked exclamations and the added colour detail (porters swinging brooms) together with the polite 'do be careful' and 'I insist'. Together they read like a careful imitation more than Westwood's sparser lines.
